title: 5 Shonen Protagonists Who Are the Perfect Examples of Shonen Heroes
content: Shueisha’s Shonen Jump is responsible for creating some of the most iconic characters and series in the anime and manga industry, helping popularize the shonen genre around the world. While shonen stories are not bound by a strict formula, they have developed a recognizable identity over the decades.
author: ComicBook

title: Live-Action Weak Hero Producer Warns of Casting Scams Amid Season 3 Rumors
content: Production company Playlist Studio has issued a warning about individuals impersonating casting staff for the live-action Weak Hero series' possible third season, following reports of fraudulent approaches circulating online.
author: ANN

title: Witch Hat Atelier Is Redefining Magic Anime, and One Detail Proves It’s the Genre’s Best Ever
content: Witch Hat Atelier is currently airing, and with each new episode, it continues to prove why it is one of the most outstanding anime released in recent years. The series is equipped with all the right elements, thanks to the brilliant production by Bugs Film, which elevates every aspect of the anime.
author: ComicBook

title: Webtoon-based Live-Action Series Back to Work! to Debut on June 22
content: Korean broadcasting studio tvN revealed on May 30 the webtoon-based live-action series Back to Work! will debut on June 22. tvN also recently revealed a teaser trailer and posters.
author: ANN

title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3's New Video Unveils Ending Song
content: The staff for Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation III , the third season of the Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation anime, presented its third promotional video on Thursday. The video announces and previews the ending theme song "Inori, Owareba" (If the Prayers Are Over) by singer Mika Nakashima .
author: ANN

title: Seimaru Amagi, Rima Amamiya's Gifted Manga Gets Anime in 2027
content: Kodansha 's Nakayoshi magazine revealed on Thursday that storywriter Seimaru Amagi and artist Rima Amamiya 's Gifted manga is getting an anime that will be "broadcast" in 2027. Amamiya posted a celebration illustration on X/Twitter on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: The Cat and the Dragon Anime Unveils 1st Promo Video, 3 More Cast Members, July 4 Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of Amara 's Neko to Ryū ( The Cat and the Dragon ) novels revealed on Thursday the anime's first promotional video, additional cast members, and July 4 debut.
author: ANN

title: 'Mebius Dust' Unveils Additional Cast, Staff, Ending Theme, Main Promo
content: The official website for the Mebius Dust television anime unveiled additional cast, staff, ending theme, a key visual, and the main promotional video on Thursday. The anime will premiere on Tokyo MX at 11.30 p.m. followed by BS Fuji and MBS on July 9.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Manga 'Gifted' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: Publishing company Kodansha announced a television anime adaptation of Shin Kibayashi and Rima Amamiya 's Gifted manga on Thursday, revealing an announcement visual (pictured above). The anime series will premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList
